input_boundaries: Lower inclusive and upper exclusive, except final upper36000 inclusive.
natural_generation: Greedy BI0,thinking disabled,EOS allowed. No forced short answers.
selection: Audit every feasible original prompt in the declared tasks. Generate natural lengths before selection. Select by frozen deterministic ordering within cells,not serving performance. No duplicates,filler or new context truncation. If a cell is short,allocate remaining requests within its input bucket by adjacent output-bin distance,then globally by input-bin distance. Keep shortages and pool/selected distribution shifts visible.

hybrid.D: Prefix upper m layers and suffix all36 layers with exact causal dependencies.

confirmation: Three independent server starts. Up to five for predeclared uncertain representative cells. Include Layer candidates,Token winners,boundaries and native/no-offload controls. Never repeat until a preferred sign appears.
scope: A new campaign. Previous HOLD and NO-GO results retain their original model/workload/runtime scope. No online dynamic insertion before correctness and deadline gates.
